# R33 exterior literature source

`truth_status=proved-standard`

William M. Goldman, *Trace Coordinates on Fricke Spaces of Some Simple
Hyperbolic Surfaces*, Handbook of Teichmüller Theory II (2009),
[arXiv:0901.1404](https://arxiv.org/abs/0901.1404), defines the multiplicative
commutator as `[A,B] = ABA^-1B^-1`. In equation (2.2.8), with
`x=tr(A)`, `y=tr(B)`, and `z=tr(AB)`, the paper derives

```text
tr([A,B]) = x^2 + y^2 + z^2 - xyz - 2.
```

Goldman attributes the rank-two trace-coordinate theorem to Vogt and Fricke.
This record therefore uses the conventional name **Fricke--Vogt commutator
trace identity** for the exact general identity. The attribution is an exterior
literature name; it was not available to either sealed R33 executable.

Source locator: Section 2.2, equation (2.2.8), PDF page 12 (document page 11).
Publisher DOI: [10.4171/055-1/16](https://doi.org/10.4171/055-1/16).
